name: SEA by the Bay: Summer Engineering Academy
description_short: A one-week overnight engineering program on Roger Williams University's waterfront campus for high school juniors and above. Teams design, build and test coastal-themed prototypes with RWU engineering faculty, and afternoons include a boat tour and coastal field trips.
